title: Get Team Name Safely
instructions:
Write a function called `getTeamName` that takes a parameter `name` of type `String?` and returns a `String`.

- If `name` is not null, return the name.
- If `name` is null, return `"Unknown Team"`.

For example:
- `getTeamName("Tribots")` returns `"Tribots"`
- `getTeamName(null)` returns `"Unknown Team"`
hint: This is similar to the previous exercise. Use an if/else to check whether `name` is null.
